task_description: Write a method in Dafny to return the negative numbers from an integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method GetNegativeNumbers(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: array<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - All elements in the output array are negative numbers
    - Every negative number in the input array appears in the output array
    - The order of negative numbers in the output array corresponds to their order in the input array
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.  
In this case:  
```dafny
method FindNegatives(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: seq<int>)
```  

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.  
Natural language description:  
- The input array can be null or non-null, but for safety, we require it to be non-null.  
Dafny specification:  
```dafny
requires arr != null
```  

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.  
Natural language description:  
- The output sequence contains exactly those elements of the input array which are negative (less than zero).  
- The order of elements in the output sequence matches their order in the input array.  
- The output sequence contains no duplicates (assuming we want unique negatives).  
Dafny specification:  
```dafny
ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |negatives| ==> negatives[i] < 0
ensures forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |negatives| ==> negatives[i] != negatives[j]
ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |negatives| ==> exists k :: 0 <= k < arr.Length && arr[k] == negatives[i]
```  

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations.  

```dafny
predicate IsNegative(x: int)
{
    x < 0
}

method FindNegatives(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: seq<int>)
    requires arr != null
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |negatives| ==> negatives[i] < 0
    ensures forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |negatives| ==> negatives[i] != negatives[j]
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |negatives| ==> exists k :: 0 <= k < arr.Length && arr[k] == negatives[i]
{
    negatives := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i < arr.Length
        invariant 0 <= i <= arr.Length
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < |negatives| ==> negatives[k] in arr[..] && IsNegative(negatives[k])
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> exists m :: 0 <= m < arr.Length && arr[m] == negatives[k]
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < |negatives| ==> negatives[k] in arr[..] && IsNegative(negatives[k])
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < |negatives| ==> exists m :: 0 <= m < arr.Length && arr[m] == negatives[k]
    {
        if arr[i] < 0
        {
            // To avoid duplicates, check if already in negatives
            if !exists j :: 0 <= j < |negatives| && negatives[j] == arr[i]
            {
                negatives := negatives + [arr[i]];
            }
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
